additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
The customer is using DepotFinity and he is also using RFID cards for authentication of charging session at the SID. Each RFID card is being used to charge several different vehicles. Now he wants to find out, which transaction belongs to which vehicle.
The only idea to get a connection is, to have the (DepotFinity) Transaction ID visible in the HMI of the SID. Then an employee can write down this number, when he plugs in the vehicle and inform his manager about that. Is there a way to display the (DepotFinity) Transaction ID in the HMI of the SID?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434946-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2 / S5 313662781001] Unable to distinguish between transaction IDs CRM:02919000078
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Kupfer,
Here is the answer of your questions:
Can the Transaction ID be displayed on the HMI?
DepotFinity provides a
Transaction Management API
that allows you to:
Retrieve transaction details using parameters like
chargerId
,
connectorId
,
vehicleId
, or
transactionID
.
Each transaction includes a unique
TransactionID
, which can be fetched in real-time or after the session.
However,
DepotFinity itself does not control the HMI of the SID
. The ability to display the
TransactionID
on the HMI depends on:
SID firmware and software capabilities
.
Integration between the SID and DepotFinity APIs
.
✅ Recommended Solution
To achieve the desired functionality:
SID Software Integration
:
The SID must be configured to
call the DepotFinity API
after RFID authentication and session initiation.
It should retrieve the
TransactionID
using the API and
display it on the HMI
.
Implementation Steps
:
Use the
Get All Transactions
or
Get Specific Transaction
endpoint from DepotFinity.
Match the transaction using
chargerId
,
connectorId
, and timestamp.
Extract the
TransactionID
and push it to the HMI display.
Alternative (Manual Logging)
:
If SID cannot be modified, the employee can
note the timestamp and RFID used
, and the manager can later
query DepotFinity
using the API to match the transaction.
🔧 Technical Reference
DepotFinity Transaction Management API Documentation
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
